Nov 9, 2026

[Nov 9, 2026\\
\\
**Create and manage campaigns and subaccounts through the REST API**\\
\\
You can now create campaigns and subaccounts through the Fundraise Up REST API. Your developers can also update, enable, disable, and archive campaigns from your own systems instead of the Dashboard.](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/changelog/campaigns-and-subaccounts-in-rest-api/)

New functionality

APIs

Nov 5, 2026

[![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 696 392'%3E%3C/svg%3E)![](https://max.ucarecdn.com/1e84d8a8-2b6b-40d2-8264-dd759f9bb025/-/preview/80x80/-/format/auto/-/quality/lighter/-/blur/36/)![](https://max.ucarecdn.com/1e84d8a8-2b6b-40d2-8264-dd759f9bb025/-/format/auto/-/quality/lighter/-/resize/1392x/)\\
\\
Nov 5, 2026\\
\\
**Tap to Donate and Giving Station are now available in the United Kingdom**\\
\\
Organizations in the United Kingdom can now collect in-person donations with Tap to Donate and Giving Station. Donations are in British pounds, and supporters can claim Gift Aid.](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/changelog/tap-to-donate-and-giving-station-in-the-uk/)

New functionality

Campaign management

Nov 5, 2026

[Nov 5, 2026\\
\\
**Fee coverage options for in-person donations**\\
\\
Tap to Donate and Giving Station campaigns, which take in-person donations through the Fundraise Up app, now let you choose how supporters can cover transaction costs. You can preselect the option, let supporters opt in, include the fees in every donation, or turn the option off.](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/changelog/fee-coverage-options-for-in-person-donations/)

Improvement

Campaign configuration

Nov 5, 2026

[Nov 5, 2026\\
\\
**Renewal reminders for supporters in California**\\
\\
You can now send supporters in California an email 30 days before their annual recurring donation renews. The email states the date and amount of the upcoming donation and links to their plan in Donor Portal, so supporters have time to update their payment details or change the plan before the renewal.](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/changelog/renewal-reminders-for-supporters-in-california/)

New functionality

Emails

Nov 4, 2026

[Nov 4, 2026\\
\\
**Your organization’s cause on P2P pages**\\
\\
P2P fundraiser pages can now show a short description of your organization's cause below the fundraiser's story. Visitors see who receives their donation and what it supports, in your organization's own words. You can also clone P2P campaigns, and team members' pages now have a Join team button, like the team page.](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/changelog/your-organizations-cause-on-p2p-pages/)

Improvement

Fundraisers

Nov 3, 2026

[![](data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 696 392'%3E%3C/svg%3E)![](https://max.ucarecdn.com/090fc897-c5ce-4cd8-8dbd-5b63623fae5c/-/preview/80x80/-/format/auto/-/quality/lighter/-/blur/36/)![](https://max.ucarecdn.com/090fc897-c5ce-4cd8-8dbd-5b63623fae5c/-/format/auto/-/quality/lighter/-/resize/1392x/)\\
\\
Nov 3, 2026\\
\\
**Sponsorship: let supporters sponsor a person or an animal**\\
\\
You can now let supporters sponsor a specific person or animal in your program with a recurring donation. Sponsorship fits child sponsorship, programs that support specific adults, and animal sponsorship at shelters, sanctuaries, and zoos.](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/changelog/sponsorship/)

New functionality

Campaign management

Nov 3, 2026

[Nov 3, 2026\\
\\
**Edit gifts on their own Dashboard page in Gift Cart**\\
\\
In Gift Cart, the settings of each gift now open on their own page in the Dashboard instead of a pop-up window. Each part of the settings has its own section, and your changes in all sections are saved at once.](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/changelog/edit-gifts-on-own-dashboard-page/)

Improvement

Campaign management

Nov 3, 2026

[Nov 3, 2026\\
\\
**Accept BECS direct debit donations from New Zealand bank accounts**\\
\\
Organizations with a Stripe account in New Zealand can now accept BECS direct debit, the bank debit system used in New Zealand. Supporters can give one-time donations in NZD from their New Zealand bank account: they enter the account number at checkout and authorize the debit.](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/changelog/nz-becs-direct-debit/)

New functionality

Payment methods

Oct 29, 2026

[Oct 29, 2026\\
\\
**Suggested amounts and impact descriptions in Tap to Donate and Giving Station**\\
\\
Tap to Donate and Giving Station campaigns can now suggest donation amounts on the donation screen, with a default amount for each frequency. You can also show an impact description with each amount, so supporters see what their donation pays for.](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/changelog/suggested-amounts-in-tap-to-donate-and-giving-station/)

New functionality

Campaign configuration

Oct 28, 2026

[Oct 28, 2026\\
\\
**Separate salutation and title fields for Germany and Austria**\\
\\
Organizations in Germany and Austria can now ask supporters for a salutation and an academic title in two separate fields. Supporters can choose Herr, Frau, Divers, or Familie as their salutation, and can pick a title, such as Dr. or Mag.a, from a list or type their own.](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/changelog/separate-salutation-and-title-fields/)

Improvement

Campaign configuration

Oct 28, 2026

[Oct 28, 2026\\
\\
**Sync data to custom objects in HubSpot and Virtuous**\\
\\
The HubSpot and Virtuous integrations can now sync Fundraise Up data to custom objects, which are record types that your organization creates in its CRM for data the standard sync doesn't write to. In HubSpot, these are custom objects on an Enterprise plan. In Virtuous, they are custom collections for Contacts and Individuals.](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/changelog/custom-object-mapping-in-hubspot-and-virtuous/)

New functionality

Integrations

Oct 26, 2026

[Oct 26, 2026\\
\\
**AI assistants can now offer supporters your campaign designations**\\
\\
AI assistants can now tell supporters which designations your campaign offers, so they can direct a donation to a specific fund or program. When a supporter picks one in the conversation, your Campaign Page or Checkout Modal opens with that designation selected.](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/changelog/ai-assistants-offer-campaign-designations/)

Improvement

Campaign configuration

Oct 23, 2026

[Oct 23, 2026\\
\\
**Sync data to custom objects in Bloomerang and DonorPerfect**\\
\\
The Bloomerang and DonorPerfect integrations can now sync Fundraise Up data to custom objects, which are record types that the standard sync doesn't write to. In Bloomerang, these are Interactions and Tasks. In DonorPerfect, they are Contact and Other Info records.](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/changelog/custom-object-mapping-in-bloomerang-and-donorperfect/)

New functionality

Integrations

Oct 22, 2026

[Oct 22, 2026\\
\\
**Accept Wero donations from supporters in Belgium, France, Germany, and Luxembourg**\\
\\
Organizations can now enable Wero, a pan-European payment method built on bank transfers rather than cards. Supporters in Belgium, France, Germany, and Luxembourg can use it for one-time donations in EUR, and they approve each payment in the Wero app.](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/changelog/wero-payment-method/)

New functionality

Payment methods

Oct 21, 2026

[Oct 21, 2026\\
\\
**More ways to share P2P fundraiser pages**\\
\\
Fundraisers and their supporters can now share fundraiser pages through WhatsApp, Messenger, and Threads. The new channels are turned on in every P2P campaign, including the ones you already run.](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/changelog/more-ways-to-share-p2p-fundraiser-pages/)

Improvement

Fundraisers

Oct 21, 2026

[Oct 21, 2026\\
\\
**Send subaccount events through a parent account webhook**\\
\\
A webhook in your parent account can now send events from your subaccounts as well. One endpoint receives activity from your whole organization, so you don't need a separate webhook in every subaccount.](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/changelog/subaccount-events-in-webhooks/)

Improvement

APIs

Oct 21, 2026

[Oct 21, 2026\\
\\
**Access P2P fundraiser pages as the fundraiser**\\
\\
Your team can now sign in as a P2P fundraiser, both on their page and in Fundraiser Portal, where fundraisers manage their pages. When a fundraiser asks for help, you can make the change yourself rather than explain each step to them.](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/changelog/access-p2p-fundraiser-pages-as-the-fundraiser/)

New functionality

Fundraisers

Oct 21, 2026

[Oct 21, 2026\\
\\
**One more retry for failed recurring installments**\\
\\
Fundraise Up now makes one more attempt to charge a failed installment on recurring plans that charge monthly or every 4 weeks. Each of these installments gets up to six charge attempts instead of five.](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/changelog/one-more-retry-for-failed-recurring-installments/)

Improvement

Campaign management

Oct 19, 2026

[Oct 19, 2026\\
\\
**Zakat Calculator: a new Nisab option and a new name**\\
\\
The Zakat Calculator, which helps supporters work out their yearly Zakat and donate it on your website, has a new Nisab option and a new name. Supporters can now enter a Nisab amount set by their imam or local Islamic organization instead of basing it on gold or silver.](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/changelog/zakat-calculator-update/)

Improvement

Elements

Oct 15, 2026

[Oct 15, 2026\\
\\
**All your campaigns, grouped in one Dashboard menu**\\
\\
We grouped all campaign types in your Dashboard under one Campaigns item in the left-side menu. The list you knew as Campaigns is now called Standard campaigns.](https://fundraiseup.com/docs/changelog/all-campaign-types-in-one-place/)

Improvement

Dashboard
